feedback: can u try to make this a bit more 2.5D ish but still be faithful

selection.reason: Adding a 2.5D visual style only requires modifying the render function to draw objects with faux depth (extrusion, shadows, isometric projection) while leaving the 2D physics and mechanics intact.

patch.notes: Added simulated 3D thickness by layering rectangles with darker colors offset downward on the Y axis, producing an orthographic 2.5D look. Extruded the environment (river banks, floes, igloo, HUD) and the player, and added a scalable drop shadow for jumps to enhance depth.
